CommunityApplications.Profile: Steward: runs Claude Code as an always-on service on your Unraid server, reachable from the Claude app or claude.ai/code through Remote Control. Independent of the array and Docker. Requires Unraid 7.3 or newer with Internal Boot; USB boot is not supported. One plugin, MIT licensed, fully open source. Support and bug reports: https://github.com/hom-wang/steward/issues
